changes: Chopping one spot now widens the axe's bites across the trunk into a real notch, instead of a tall narrow slot down the log.
The notch reaches round the trunk's corners, thin trunks included.
Wood cracks now show around the bites as you chop.
A swing after the tree falls bites the stump instead of wiping out the gash; chop the stump down to clear it, and it drops wood.
